business: Fatma Al Moosa Advocate and Legal Consultancy
summary: A Dubai law firm that claims to be one of the largest appears to lose enquiries to dead menu links and thin proof.

findings.problem: Menu items Our Services, About us and Products appear to link to #, and a Products item appears on a law firm site.
findings.cost: Dead links and an odd menu item confuse visitors who came to hire a lawyer.
findings.fix: Working links and a menu built around practice areas.

findings.problem: The page appears to claim one of the leading and largest law firms in Dubai, with no lawyer names, case results or reviews shown.
findings.cost: A big claim with no proof pushes clients to firms that show results.
findings.fix: Named lawyers, results and client reviews.

findings.problem: The firm name with Law Firm appears repeated in awkward sentences, and English (US) appears twice in the language menu.
findings.cost: Clumsy repeats look unfinished to corporate and private clients.
findings.fix: Rewritten homepage copy and a clean language switch.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp appears, only a phone number and a contact link.
findings.cost: Clients in Dubai expect to message a firm first.
findings.fix: WhatsApp and a booking form for a case review.
